notes.title: Demo Available Now!!
notes.content:
The full release of Morningtide Motel is coming up soon, and in preparation, we are taking part in this months Steam Next Fest! As such, [b]the demo for Morningtide Motel is now available to play[/b], right on the Morningtide Motel store page! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036220/Morningtide_Motel/]Please consider checking it out![/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036220/Morningtide_Motel/

The demo release is only available for Windows, but we have included a Mac and Linux version of the demo in this playtest app in case you want to try out an untested version!

As always, thank you so much for playing and your incredible playtesting work, and we hope you enjoy [b]Morningtide Motel![/b]

notes.title: NextFest Demo Playtest Now Live!
notes.content: Check your email for an update about the current round of playtesting!

notes.title: Initial Public Playtest Build!
notes.content: Thank you for playtesting Morningtide Motel! Please remember to take notes on your experience playing, and follow the links in your Key email to find where to give us feedback. Thanks again!
